observation: The mutation-smoke gate failed because pytest in the isolated temporary campaign root did not load tests/conftest.py when the sentinel test path was passed as an absolute argument: with no config file at the campaign root, pytest sets rootdir to the test file's own directory and never ascends to load the parent tests/conftest.py, so the session-scoped `root` fixture used by test_kills_contract_validity_mutant was reported as not found (infrastructure-error for all mutants).
evidence: scripts/mutation_smoke.py; tests/conftest.py (def root); harness.sh; reproduced by copying src/tests/benchmark into a temp root and running pytest with an absolute test path (fixture 'root' not found) versus a relative path or explicit --rootdir (1 passed)
attempted_strategy: Ran the isolated subprocess with an explicit `--rootdir=<campaign-root>` so pytest treats the campaign root as rootdir and loads tests/conftest.py regardless of the argument path type.
result: With --rootdir set, all nine mutation sentinels are killed (killed=9, survive=0, infra=0, score=1.0, passed=true) and the harness proceeds past the mutation gate.
proposed_heuristic: When isolating a pytest subprocess into a temporary root, always pass the absolute campaign root via `--rootdir` (in addition to setting PYTHONPATH) so parent conftest.py fixtures are loaded; do not rely on relative-path rootdir inference that silently drops parent conftest files.
scope: process-only (scripts/mutation_smoke.py); no effect on normative tasks, ontologies, rubrics or scorers
contamination_risk: Minimal; applies only to the deterministic reproduction harness, not to benchmark measurement.
